title: The Hermit
subtitle: invisible until one task has progress
description: A quest nobody can see until they have stumbled onto part of it. `invisible`
hides it until it is completed; `invisibleUntilTasks: 1` reveals it earlier -- as
soon as one of its tasks has any progress at all.
Pick up a single ender pearl and this node appears on the canvas, from nowhere,
with no line drawn to it and nothing to explain it. That is the easter egg.
